arabic text: ZAINAB MERI BEHNA, DUKHYA MERI BEHNA\nTUM FATEHA SHARBAT PE DILANA MERI BEHNA
english translation text: ZAINAB MY SISTER, MY HEARTBROKEN SISTER\nRECITE A FATEHA BEFORE DRINKING ANY DRINK (IN MY REMEMBRANCE)

arabic text: GHAR BAAD MERE PANI MAYASSAR TUMHE HOWE\nPEHLE TUM SAKINA KO PILANA MERI BEHNA
english translation text: THEY WILL BRING WATER TO THE TENTS AFTER I PASS AWAY\nO SISTER, MAKE MY SAKINA DRINK IT FIRST

arabic text: MAQTAL KI TARAF SE TUMHE LE JAYEGE ZALIM\nPYARI KO ALAMDAR NA DIKHANA MERI BEHNA
english translation text: THESE ENEMIES WILL WALK THE CARAVAN PAST THE BATTLEFIELD\nO SISTER, DO NOT LET MY BELOVED DAUGHTER SEE HER UNCLE

arabic text: JAB CHUT KE QAID SUWEY WATAN JAYIYO ZAINAB\nSUGHRA KO SEENAY SE LAGAANA MERI BEHNA
english translation text: WHEN THEY RELEASE YOU FROM PRISON AND YOU GO HOME\nO SISTER, HUG MY DAUGHTER SUGHRA FOR ME

arabic text: AAOGE TUM TO RUH KO SADMA MERI HOGA\nLAASHE PE MERI AANSU BAHANA MERI BEHNA
english translation text: WHEN YOU RETURN, MY SOUL WILL BE IN PAIN\nO SISTER, SHED SOME TEARS ON MY GRAVE
